mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals active monetary easing that lowers equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 8.0% signal severe labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 220 signals high inflation, prompting potential monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 220, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production indicates expanding manufacturing output, signaling economic recovery and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth, measured by GDPC1, signals robust economic expansion and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth is positive, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Employment growth declining below -0.5% over three months signals worsening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth rate falls below -0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment combined with declining federal funds rate signals recessionary policy response, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0% and FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
